skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.heavy_: Crossbows hit much harder, but you walk slower while holding one.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.patien: Shots from far away hit harder; shots from up close hit weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.volley: Your projectiles hit harder, but your melee attacks hit weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.maste: You mine much faster, but your tools wear out sooner.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.tinke: Your tools last much longer, but you mine slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.wayfi: You move faster and fall farther without getting hurt, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.death: Near death your melee hits are devastating, but healing works worse on you.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.jugge: Heavy weapons hit harder and you are hard to push around, but you attack slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.reckl: You deal more melee damage, but you also take more damage.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.swift_h: You swing light weapons much faster, but each hit is a little weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.thousan: You land critical hits far more often, but each one is weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.wind_da: You dodge attacks more often, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.bastio: You have much more health, but you move slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.living: You take less damage from everything, but your attacks are weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.rooted: You are very hard to push and better armored, but you jump lower.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.unbrok: You are a bit harder to push; when your health is low you briefly take less damage.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.arcane: Magic hurts you much less, but your attacks are weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.elixir: Healing works much better on you, but you have less health.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.tinctu: Your potions last longer and drinking one heals you a little.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.volati: Your potions last much longer, but magic hurts you more.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.dead_e: Firearms hit harder; a headshot makes you stronger and reloading makes you faster for a moment.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.flurry_: With a weapon in each hand you hit harder, and finishing a combo makes you faster for a moment.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.ring_b: You can wear one more ring, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.charm_: You can wear one more charm, but you have less armor.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.slider: Only a pickaxe can break the Slider, and now yours breaks everything else: holding a pickaxe, you deal 6 more attack damage. Hidden until you beat the Slider.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.valkyri: You fight like a Valkyrie: you reach 2 blocks farther with attacks and hands, and falling never hurts you. Hidden until you beat the Valkyrie Queen.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.sun_sp: Your body burns like the Sun Spirit's: fire and lava barely hurt you and whoever hurts you catches fire, but freezing hurts twice as much. Hidden until you beat the Sun Spirit.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.brass: When you are hurt, a gust of wind throws back every enemy within 6 blocks, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you clear the Brass Dungeon.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.naga_s: You charge like the Naga: while sprinting, your melee blows deal 30% more damage and send the target flying. Hidden until you defeat the Twilight Forest Naga.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.lich_p: Press the Hidden Power key to raise a Loyal Zombie beside you that fights for you for 30 seconds, once every 20 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Lich.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.hydra: Cut off one head and another grows: every time you are hurt you gain one more level of Strength, up to III, for 6 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Hydra.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.ghast_: Every kill with a projectile sheds a ghast tear on you: Regeneration II for 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Ur-Ghast.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.frozen_: Your fully drawn shots carry the Snow Queen's frost: the target is Frosted and slowed for 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Snow Queen.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.ignis: Your critical hits set the target on fire and sear Ignis' Blazing Brand into it for 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Ignis.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.ender_g: When an enemy hurts you, you blink behind it, once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Ender Guardian.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.harbin: Your fully drawn shots lock on like the Harbinger's eye: the target glows through walls for 10 seconds and withers for 6. Hidden until you defeat the Harbinger.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.leviat: When you are hurt the abyss answers: every enemy within 5 blocks suffers the Leviathan's Abyssal Burn for 5 seconds, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Leviathan.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.maledi: When your health falls below 30% you turn into a ghost for 4 seconds: nothing can hurt you, but you cannot attack or use items. Once every 3 minutes. Hidden until you defeat Maledictus.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.scylla: Your fully drawn shots call Scylla's storm: lightning strikes the target for 5 hearts of damage, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Scylla.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.drago: Your critical hits encase the target in dragon ice for 3 seconds, once every 15 seconds. Hidden until you kill a dragon.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.hydra: Your critical hits bite like a hydra's fangs: they poison the target and heal you for a heart, once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a hydra.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.serpe: While wet, in water or in the rain, you swim 50% faster and your attacks deal 20% more damage. Hidden until you kill a sea serpent.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.frostm: Press the Hidden Power key to roar like Frostmaw: every enemy within 6 blocks is frozen solid for 3 seconds, once every 30 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Frostmaw.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.wroug: While sneaking you stand like the Wroughtnaut: melee blows hurt 60% less and nothing pushes you. Hidden until you defeat the Ferrous Wroughtnaut.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.umvuth: Press the Hidden Power key to call a sunstrike down on the block you are looking at, up to 32 blocks away, once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Umvuthi.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.krake: Your critical hits drag every enemy within 8 blocks toward you, like the Kraken's trident, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Kraken.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.sandwo: Your critical hits erupt under the target like a sand column and throw it into the air, once every 6 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Sandworm.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.knights: You strike at the weak spot first: your blow against an unhurt enemy deals 50% more damage. Hidden until you defeat the Underworld Knight.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.warlord: Your critical hits spin a cobweb around the target's feet, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Spider Warlord.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.pumpk: Whatever you kill bursts like a pumpkin bomb, dealing 4 hearts of damage to the enemies around it. Hidden until you defeat Lord Pumpkinhead.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.shipb: A blow that would kill you leaves you with one heart instead, once every 5 minutes. Hidden until you survive the Shipbreaker.

skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.atlas_: +3 armor and 30% knockback resistance, but 5% less movement speed. Hidden until you wear the Atlas vestige.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.crowned: +1 attack damage and +4% critical chance. Hidden until you wear the Crown vestige.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.mirror_: +8% dodge chance and +5% critical chance. Hidden until you kill the Dark Doppelganger.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.ymirs_: +2 hearts and 20% knockback resistance. Hidden until you wear the Rune of Ymir.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.fafni: +20% critical damage, and your critical hits set the target on fire for 5 seconds, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you wear the Rune of Fafnir.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.eye_of: A fully charged shot that hits releases a gust that throws back the enemies within 6 blocks of you. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Eye of the Storm.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.minot: The Hidden Power key throws you forward in a charge. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Minoshroom.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.phanto: Blocking an attack with a shield heals 1 heart. Once every 6 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Knight Phantom.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.alpha_g: Your critical hits freeze the target in place: Slowness IV for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Alpha Yeti.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.gorgon: Your critical hits turn the target to stone for 2 seconds (Slowness V). Once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Gorgon.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.cyclo: Your critical hits burst for 8 damage on the enemies around the target. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Cyclops.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.dread_: Killing an enemy gives you Absorption II for 10 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Dread Lich.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.sculp: You step up full blocks without jumping and fall 5 blocks further without harm. Hidden until you kill the Sculptor.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.naga_s: A fully charged shot poisons the target: Poison II for 5 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Naga from Mowzie's Mobs.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.infer: Your critical hits set the target on fire for 8 seconds, once every 8 seconds, and you take 50% less fire damage. Hidden until you kill the Infernal Dragon.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.yeti_p: 80% less freezing damage taken and +2 armor. Hidden until you kill the Yeti from Block Factory's Bosses.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.captain: Dodging an attack gives you Speed II for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Pirate Captain.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.krampu: When you are hurt, the attacker is caught in a web. Once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you kill Krampus.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.stolen: Killing an enemy heals 1 heart. Once every 2 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Lifestealer in its true form.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.headl: +25% damage while your health is low. Hidden until you kill Lord the Headless.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.capta: +30% swim speed and your breath lasts much longer under water. Hidden until you kill Captain Cornelia.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.mother: A fully charged shot that hits makes the enemies within 12 blocks of you glow for 10 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Maze Mother.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.pigli: +3 hearts and 15% less magic damage taken. Hidden until you kill a Piglich.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.undyin: When your health runs low you refuse to fall: Regeneration III and Resistance II for 5 seconds. Once every 2 minutes. Hidden until you kill a monster with the Undying trait.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.chaos: Your critical hits unleash chaos on the target, at random: a lightning bolt, a launch into the air, fire, or a blast that hurts the enemies around it. Once every 4 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Chaos Guardian.
attribute.name.celestialskilltree.harves: Chance that a ripe crop you break yields one extra crop or essence.
message.celestialskilltree.telescope.no_: The stars cannot be seen from here right now: it takes an Overworld night and open sky.

command.celestialskilltree.regenerate_wa: This draws the whole skill tree again from the current catalog, as a new world would get it. Skills that are no longer in the tree are refunded to every player (offline players when they log in). Run /celestialskilltree regenerate confirm to do it.
command.celestialskilltree.regenerated: Skill tree drawn again: %s skills. Players were reconciled and refunded for skills that left the tree.
gui.celestialskilltree.status.rank_pendi: All ranks marked: click to unmark
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.contr: Steady anger: a little more melee damage and a little less damage taken, but you swing slightly slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.berserker.blind: All-out anger: much more melee damage, but you also take much more damage.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.riposte: Wait for the opening: better dodge and critical chance, but a little less health.
skill.celestialskilltree.duelist.all_in_: Commit to the hit: critical hits deal much more damage, but you dodge less.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.iron_w: Plant your feet: much more armor, but you move slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.moving: Defend on the move: less damage taken and faster steps, but less armor.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.sniper: Shoot from afar: far shots hit much harder, but you walk slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.skirmi: Shoot on the run: more projectile damage and speed, but far shots hit weaker.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.swift: Dig fast: you mine much faster, but your tools wear out sooner.
skill.celestialskilltree.artificer.spelu: Explore caves: faster steps and safer falls, but you mine slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.long_b: Slow and lasting: your potions last much longer, but healing works less on you.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.strong: Quick and strong: healing works much better on you, but your potions run out sooner.
A bigger pool: much more maximum mana, but it refills slower.
skill.celestialskilltree.arcanist.starbo: Attuned to a constellation, your spells strike far harder; without one they falter.
skill.celestialskilltree.guardian.armara: Attuned to Armara, you stand like a wall: more armor and knockback resistance, at the cost of some speed.
skill.celestialskilltree.marksman.radian: Once you reach Luminance in Astral Sorcery, your shots strike harder.
skill.celestialskilltree.mage.swift_spri: A faster flow: mana refills much faster, but you hold less of it.

skill.celestialskilltree.mage.source_glu: A huge mana pool: +100 maximum mana, but 2 less mana regeneration.
skill.celestialskilltree.mage.life_weave: Every spell that resolves heals you for 1 heart, once every 3 seconds, but you lose 2 Warding.
skill.celestialskilltree.mage.soul_reape: Slain foes give 2 more spirits and spirit effects grow stronger, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.celestialskilltree.mage.warded_sou: A much larger Soul Ward that recovers faster, but 20% less armor.
skill.celestialskilltree.mage.scythe_sai: Scythes hit 25% harder, but you take 10% more magic damage.
